default.notes: Conservative defaults suitable for most FDM printers.

ender3.display_name: Creality Ender 3 / Ender 3 Pro / Ender 3 V2
ender3.notes: PTFE-lined hotend by default — exceeding 240C risks toxic fumes. All-metal upgrade raises safe limit to 300C.

ender3_s1.notes: Sprite direct-drive extruder with a PTFE-LINED heat break — 260C ceiling, and sustained printing near it degrades the liner. The S1 Pro is a different machine with a full-metal hotend; see ender3_s1_pro.

ender5.notes: Standard Ender 5 dimensions (220x220x300). Ender 5 Plus users should create a custom profile with 350x350x400. PTFE hotend — same hotend caution as Ender 3.

ender3_v2.notes: Ender 3 V2 dimensions. Stock PTFE-lined hotend; all-metal upgrades should use a custom profile.

sparkx_i7.notes: SPARKX i7 dimensions (260x260x255). CoreXY, direct drive, open-frame four-color desktop printer.

k1.notes: Standard K1 dimensions (220x220x250). High-speed CoreXY. Passive enclosed chamber. All-metal hotend.

k1_max.notes: K1 Max dimensions (300x300x300). High-speed CoreXY. Passive enclosed chamber. All-metal hotend.

k1c.notes: K1C dimensions (220x220x250). High-speed CoreXY. Enclosed frame. Hardened/steel-tipped nozzle path.

k1_se.notes: K1 SE dimensions (220x220x250). High-speed CoreXY with direct drive.

k2.notes: K2 dimensions (260x260x260). CoreXY, direct drive, Creality Print 6 G-code/3MF workflow.

k2_pro.notes: K2 Pro dimensions (300x300x300). CoreXY, direct drive, enclosed chamber.

k2_plus.notes: K2 Plus dimensions (350x350x350). CoreXY, direct drive, enclosed chamber, 350C hotend.

k2_se.notes: K2 SE dimensions (220x215x245). CoreXY, direct drive, open-frame multi-material-ready model.

creality_hi.notes: Creality Hi dimensions (260x260x300). CoreXY, direct drive, open frame.

ender3_v4.notes: Ender-3 V4 dimensions (220x220x235). Direct-drive open-frame CFS-capable printer.

ender3_v3.notes: Ender-3 V3 dimensions (220x220x250). CoreXZ, direct drive, open frame.

ender3_v3_ke.notes: Ender-3 V3 KE dimensions (220x220x240). Klipper-class direct-drive open-frame printer.

ender3_v3_se.notes: Ender-3 V3 SE dimensions (220x220x250). Direct-drive open-frame Marlin-class printer.

ender3_v3_plus.notes: Ender-3 V3 Plus dimensions (300x300x330). CoreXZ, direct drive, open frame.

ender5_max.notes: Ender-5 Max dimensions (400x400x400). CoreXY, direct drive, open frame.

cr10_se.notes: CR-10 SE dimensions (220x220x265). Klipper-class direct-drive open-frame printer.

_meta.description: Per-printer safety profiles for Kiln G-code validation. The 'default' profile applies when no printer-specific profile matches.

field_semantics.max_hotend_temp: THE MACHINE'S RATED CAPABILITY in C, mirrored from printer_intelligence.json (the manufacturer-spec registry). It is enforced as a CRITICAL block rule by the G-code interceptor. It is NOT a guard band: do not hand-type a margin into it. A value above the rating grants rope the machine was never rated for; a value below it silently caps hardware the owner paid for. Both directions are caught by a test.
field_semantics.max_bed_temp: Same contract as max_hotend_temp, for the heated bed.
field_semantics.policy_margin: Safety MARGIN lives separately and is named: _PTFE_SAFE_MAX (240C) in server.py clamps PTFE-lined hotends below their rating, because the liner degrades before the machine does. That is what a guard band should look like — one named constant derived from a material fact, not a per-printer round number. Add new margins the same way.
field_semantics.why_this_exists: Until 2026-07-20 this file and the registry disagreed on 17 values. printer_intelligence had been backfilled from manufacturer specs; this file never had an equivalent pass, so it had collapsed 250/260/290-rated machines into a round 300. Nothing compared them.

prusa_mk3s.notes: E3D V6 all-metal hotend. Bontech gears.

prusa_mk4.notes: Nextruder with all-metal hotend. Input shaping.

prusa_xl.notes: CoreXY, segmented heatbed, up to 5 tool heads.

prusa_mini.notes: PTFE-lined hotend — reduced max temp. Bowden setup.

bambu_x1c.notes: Enclosed CoreXY. Hardened nozzle. AMS multi-material. LiDAR first-layer inspection.

bambu_x1e.notes: Enclosed CoreXY, enterprise variant. Active heated chamber (40-60C). Factory hardened-steel nozzle (abrasive-ready out of the box). Full AMS multi-material. LiDAR + AI first-layer inspection. 320C hotend ceiling (vs 300C X1C) for PPS/PPA at the top of their window.

bambu_p1s.notes: Enclosed CoreXY. Same hotend as X1C without LiDAR.

bambu_p2s.notes: Enclosed CoreXY, PMSM servo direct drive. All-metal hardened-steel hotend (abrasive-ready). AMS 2 Pro multi-material. Passive chamber (no active heater, ~50C); ceiling matches the enclosed P-series. 600 mm/s toolhead = feedrate 36000 (vs 30000 on P1S). Bed 110C, hotend 300C.

bambu_a1_mini.notes: Compact bed-slinger. All-metal hotend. AMS Lite compatible.

bambu_a1.notes: Open-frame bed-slinger. All-metal hotend. AMS Lite compatible.

bambu_a2l.notes: Open-frame large-format bed-slinger (330x320x325). PMSM closed-loop servo extruder. Stainless-steel nozzle (NOT hardened) - fit hardened for carbon-fibre. 80C bed cap blocks ABS/ASA/PA/PC. No heated chamber, no LiDAR/AI camera. 2.4GHz Wi-Fi only.

bambu_h2s.notes: Enclosed CoreXY, direct drive. All-metal hardened-steel factory hotend (abrasive-ready out of the box). Active heated chamber to 65C (engages ~40C) with a 120C bed and 350C hotend - the full engineering-material envelope (ABS/ASA/PC/PA/CF). AMS 2 Pro multi-material via the AMS Hub. 1000 mm/s toolhead = feedrate 60000. Volumetric-flow ceiling 32 mm3/s is conservative pending field data on the high-flow hotend. AI chamber monitoring + physical clump detector; no LiDAR first-layer inspection.

voron_0.notes: Compact enclosed CoreXY kit. Limits depend on hotend choice.

voron_2.notes: Full-size enclosed CoreXY kit. Typical configs use Dragon/Rapido hotend.

ratrig_vcore3.notes: CoreXY kit. Limits depend on hotend choice. Usually EVA toolhead.

elegoo_neptune3.notes: PTFE-lined hotend. Direct drive. Same temp caution as Ender 3.

elegoo_centauri_carbon.notes: High-speed CoreXY with SDCP protocol. Enclosed, active chamber heating. All-metal hotend with a brass-hardened steel nozzle rated to 320C by the manufacturer. The ceiling here read 300C until 2026-07-20, which capped the machine 20C below its rated hotend and blocked its top of range for no stated reason; corrected to the manufacturer's figure, which the printer registry already carried.

elegoo_orangestorm_giga.notes: Large-format Klipper printer. Uses Moonraker adapter. All-metal hotend.

artillery_sw_x3.display_name: Artillery Sidewinder X3 Plus / X3 Pro

sovol_sv06.notes: Prusa MK3S clone. All-metal hotend. Planetary gear extruder.

qidi_x_plus3.notes: Enclosed CoreXY. High-temp hotend for engineering filaments. Klipper firmware.

klipper_generic.notes: Generic Klipper/Moonraker printer with all-metal hotend. No enclosure assumed. Adjust limits to match your hardware.

aon_m2_plus.notes: Industrial high-temperature FFF. Dual independent extruders, actively heated 135 C chamber, 500 C+ extruder, 200 C+ bed. The only genuinely open high-temp machine in this class: it runs Klipper behind a browser interface, so Kiln reaches it through the existing Moonraker adapter.

qidi_plus4.notes: Enclosed CoreXY with a 370 C bimetal nozzle and 65 C independent chamber heating — the highest hotend of any consumer machine here, and enough for unfilled PPS. Klipper firmware with a Fluidd web interface, so the existing Moonraker adapter reaches it.

qidi_q1_pro.notes: Compact enclosed CoreXY, 350 C ceramic-heated bimetal hotend with 60 C independent chamber heating. Klipper firmware — reachable through the existing Moonraker adapter.

qidi_x_max3.notes: Large-format enclosed CoreXY, 350 C hotend, 65 C actively heated chamber, integrated dryer box. Ships both a copper-alloy and a hardened-steel hotend, so abrasive filled grades need no upgrade. Klipper firmware — existing Moonraker adapter reaches it.

qidi_q2.notes: Enclosed CoreXY with a 370 C bimetal hardened-steel nozzle and 65 C second-generation independent chamber heating — the same hotend ceiling as the Plus 4 in a smaller frame, so unfilled PPS is in range. Klipper, so the existing Moonraker adapter reaches it.

ender3_s1_pro.notes: Sprite Pro full-metal direct-drive extruder — rated to 300C with a titanium throat and no PTFE in the hot zone, so high-temperature filaments are safe here in a way they are not on the base S1. Open-frame bed-slinger, so ABS and ASA still warp without an enclosure.
